basis: Project-specific engineering priority: main FieldOps journeys, existing verified adapters, credentials already supplied, and remaining implementation work. This is not a scientific ranking of provider accuracy.

priorities.name: Open-Meteo
priorities.reason: Forecast weather for planting timing, inspection and short-term planning.

priorities.name: iSDAsoil
priorities.reason: Mapped soil properties, depth and uncertainty for plot context; user credential is already stored.

priorities.name: NASA POWER
priorities.reason: Historical temperature, radiation, humidity, wind and precipitation context through the existing REST adapter.

priorities.name: CHIRPS / ClimateSERV
priorities.reason: Historical rainfall complements forecasts; current adapter remains restricted to the synthetic Adama polygon.

priorities.name: FAO FPMA
priorities.reason: Economic context for crop planning after agricultural evidence; preserve market, currency, units and dates.

priorities.name: Kindwise Crop.health
priorities.reason: Supports the crop-photo case and has a stored key; finish the authorized image workflow before any credit-consuming call.

priorities.name: Copernicus Sentinel Hub
priorities.reason: Vegetation statistics for registered polygons and map-based follow-up; credentials and polygon/no-data handling are pending.

priorities.name: FAO WaPOR
priorities.reason: Water and evapotranspiration evidence; add the controlled raster/range transport first.

priorities.name: FAO Locust Hub
priorities.reason: Regional pest surveillance supplements field checks; reported observations are not plot diagnoses.

priorities.name: NASA POWER public MCP
priorities.reason: Alternative interface to NASA POWER data and an MCP integration demonstration; not an independent corroborating dataset.

priorities.name: CABI PMDG
priorities.reason: Reviewed crop/pest management knowledge once licensed access and provenance are available.

priorities.name: EPPO Global Database
priorities.reason: Pest taxonomy and reference enrichment after the core field-evidence flow works.

priorities.name: FAO GAEZ
priorities.reason: Potential crop-suitability context, but numerical extraction was not established by the prior tests.

priorities.name: FAO ASIS
priorities.reason: Regional agricultural stress context; previously blocked raster retrieval must be resolved.

priorities.name: Google Earth Engine
priorities.reason: Broader geospatial processing platform; introduces setup and overlaps the narrower satellite integrations.

priorities.name: WFP / HDX HAPI
priorities.reason: Additional price context after the first FPMA market skill is validated.

priorities.name: Plantix Intelligence
priorities.reason: Alternative diagnosis provider; API access is pending and Kindwise is already available for the image workflow.

priorities.name: DeepLeaf
priorities.reason: Additional diagnosis provider; issued access and a verified operation schema are missing.

priorities.name: KoboToolbox
priorities.reason: External field-data synchronization after the existing workspace plot/household records are in use.

priorities.name: ODK Central
priorities.reason: External field-data synchronization requires an actual configured Central server.

priorities.name: OpenRouteService
priorities.reason: Travel/logistics is outside the first agricultural-evidence workflow.

priorities.name: Africa's Talking
priorities.reason: Outbound messaging remains outside the authorized companion capabilities.

notes: NASA REST and MCP are alternative access paths to the same provider, not independent scientific corroboration.
Forecast, historical climate, rainfall estimates and mapped soil properties remain distinct evidence types.
The CHIRPS implementation currently supports only the synthetic Adama validation polygon.
Crop assessment also requires reviewed local crop/calendar rules and registered farm context.
No new external reranking service or Gemini model is required to order these integrations.
note: The ordering accounts for readiness: NASA historical climate is active; CHIRPS remains the next core requirement but is disabled after a live timeout.
